editorial.blurb: Sweet Maple Cafe is a beloved breakfast spot in Little Italy where thoughtful service and expertly executed classics like soft buttermilk pancakes and crispy cinnamon roll pancakes make every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive on a Friday morning to try their special catfish nuggets, and know that the kitchen is exceptionally accommodating with allergies—just ask about their nut-free, pea-free, and shellfish-free options.
